---
Repair and extend the SCAMP-Trie CPU pipeline in `/workspace/src`.
Make live prefix updates, compact memory snapshots, and reloaded lookup agree.
Support full 128-bit IPv6 longest prefix matching with last-write-wins puts.
A loaded image is independent of later live updates and other saved images.
Validate an entire packed image before replacing the loaded state.
Preserve the half/full node, NI bitmap, fallback, and bulk-child invariants.
Use `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md` for complete operations, bit layouts and bounds.
The supplied C++ core, exporter, entry point, and new image API are editable.
Only the complete `src/` tree is collected: regular UTF-8 files within its bounds.
The fixed Python front end and offline GNU C++ toolchain are supplied.
Build with `cd /workspace && python3 build.py` as the non-root workspace user.
The public CLI is `python3 run.py`: one JSON request and response per process.
Run `python3 public_check.py` for bounded, non-root public sanity checks.
Those examples are small; implement every documented case and boundary.
This is a CPU storage/lookup model; FPGA timing and packet rates are outside scope.
